author: IGN
description:
Street Fighter 6 is turning three years old this year, and while players are looking forward to the upcoming big patch on March 17 to hopefully significantly shake up the game's meta, we figure it's a good time to look back and check on the ways in which the game has changed since its launch. Here's Everything Added to Street Fighter 6, from new characters, to new system mechanics, to a handful of very significan balance adjustments, and more.

title: Street Fighter 6 - Everything Added Since Launch

author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the Go Forth trailer for Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection, the next installment in the Monster Hunter Stories franchise developed by Capcom. Players will embark on a grand journey to explore a variety of landscapes, meet unique characters, and most importantly, hunt monsters. Yet there’s something out there beyond anything we can imagine, and that something is the source of the Encroachment. As calamity closes in from all angles, it’s your duty to pick up the torch and see it through.
Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection is launching on March 13, 2026, on Nintendo Switch 2, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).

title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection - Official Go Forth Trailer
